list.name: cohort_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT type FROM integrations.cohorts ORDER BY type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.value AS stage, COUNT(uc.user_telegram_id) AS count
FROM integrations.cohorts c
JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.cohort_id = c.id
WHERE c.type = '$cohort_type'
  AND LOWER(c.value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive')
GROUP BY c.value
ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', st.created_at) AS time,
  st.new_value AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM integrations.stage_transitions st
WHERE st.cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
  AND st.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND LOWER(st.new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  COALESCE(st.old_value, '(новый)') AS "Из",
  st.new_value AS "В",
  COUNT(*) AS "Переходов",
  ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY st.old_value), 0) * 100, 1) AS "% от источника"
FROM integrations.stage_transitions st
WHERE st.cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
  AND st.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND LOWER(st.new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive')
  AND (st.old_value IS NULL OR LOWER(st.old_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive'))
GROUP BY st.old_value, st.new_value
ORDER BY "Переходов" DESC

WITH stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    LEAD(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at) AS ended_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = '$cohort_type'
    AND LOWER(new_value) NOT IN ('cancel', 'archive')
)
SELECT
  stage,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ended_at - started_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS "Среднее дней"
FROM stage_periods
WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
  AND started_at >= $__timeFrom()
  AND started_at < $__timeTo()
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY "Среднее дней" DESC
